'''Steven Kay Butler''' (born May 16, 1977) is an American mathematician specializing in [[graph theory]] and [[combinatorics]]. He is a Morrill Professor and the Barbara J. Janson Professor in Mathematics at [[Iowa State University]].

==Education and career==
Butler earned his master's degree at [[Brigham Young University]] in 2003. His master's thesis was titled ''Bounding the Number of Graphs Containing Very Long Induced Paths''.<ref>{{cite thesis |last1=Butler |first1=Steven Kay |title=Bounding the Number of Graphs Containing Very Long Induced Paths |type=Master's thesis |date=February 7, 2003 |url=https://scholarsarchive.byu.edu/etd/31/ |accessdate=October 6, 2018 |publisher=Brigham Young University |archive-date=October 6, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181006194907/https://scholarsarchive.byu.edu/etd/31/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He completed a doctorate at the [[University of California, San Diego]] in 2008, authoring the dissertation ''Eigenvalues and Structures of Graphs'', advised by [[Fan Chung]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=126850}}</ref><ref>{{cite thesis |last1=Butler |first1=Steven Kay |title=Eigenvalues and Structures of Graphs |url=https://orion.math.iastate.edu/butler/PDF/dissertation.pdf |publisher=University of California, San Diego |date=2008 |accessdate=October 6, 2018 |archive-date=August 30, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170830075937/http://orion.math.iastate.edu/butler/PDF/dissertation.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> Upon completing his postdoctoral studies at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]], Butler joined the [[Iowa State University]] faculty in 2011.<ref name="jansonprof"/><ref name="walk">{{cite news |last1=Bundlong |first1=Jeff |title=Walking to work: Good for the sole |url=https://www.inside.iastate.edu/article/2022/11/03/walking |access-date=April 20, 2023 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=November 3, 2022 |archive-date=April 21, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230421013316/https://www.inside.iastate.edu/article/2022/11/03/walking |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2015, Butler became the 512th (and so far final) person to have an [[Erdős number]] of 1, when he published a paper with [[Paul Erdős]] and [[Ronald Graham]] on [[Egyptian fraction]]s.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/2015/12/10/new-erdos-paper-solves-egyptian-fraction-problem/|title=New Erdős Paper Solves Egyptian Fraction Problem|first=Siobhan|last=Roberts|authorlink=Siobhan Roberts|publisher=Simons Foundation|date=December 10, 2015|access-date=October 19, 2018|archive-date=November 18, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181118160507/https://www.simonsfoundation.org/2015/12/10/new-erdos-paper-solves-egyptian-fraction-problem/|url-status=live}}</ref> In 2017, Butler was named the Barbara J. Janson Professor in Mathematics,<ref name="jansonprof">{{cite news |title=Steve Butler receives Barbara J. Janson Professorship in Mathematics |url=https://math.iastate.edu/2017/09/19/steve-butler-receives-barbara-j-janson-professorship-in-mathematics/ |accessdate=October 6, 2018 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=September 19, 2017 |archive-date=December 7, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191207202809/https://math.iastate.edu/2017/09/19/steve-butler-receives-barbara-j-janson-professorship-in-mathematics/ |url-status=live }}</ref> and to a Morrill Professorship in 2022.<ref>{{cite news |title=More than 60 faculty and staff honored with university awards |url=https://www.inside.iastate.edu/article/2022/04/28/awards |access-date=April 20, 2023 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=April 28, 2023 |archive-date=April 15, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230415141526/https://www.inside.iastate.edu/article/2022/04/28/awards |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Work with undergraduates ==
Butler has been a project lead for the Iowa State University Math [[Research Experiences for Undergraduates|REU]] in 2015, 2017, 2019, 2022, 2023, and 2024, and 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ISU Math REU Past Participants |url=https://www.mathreu.org/past-participants |access-date=December 2, 2024 |archive-date=April 21, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240421050705/https://www.mathreu.org/past-participants |url-status=live }}</ref>
